title: Self-service applications are missing a description or a publisher

messages.businessImpact: Users browsing Company Portal see unidentifiable entries, so they either install the wrong thing or call the service desk instead.
remediation: Add a description, publisher and icon for every application offered to users.
messages.cannotSee: The icon is not judged. Graph returns no icon in a list of applications, only when each one is read on its own, which is a call per application this tool does not make, so an application with a description and a publisher and no icon is not reported here.
